title: Forces on a pulled block
caption: Weight and the normal force cancel. Horizontally, 10 N forward and 4.0 N of friction leave a net 6 N, so a = F/m = 6 / 2.0 = 3.0 m s⁻².
alt: Free-body diagram of a block: weight down and normal force up, equal; a 10 newton pull to the right and 4 newtons of friction to the left; net 6 newtons to the right.
description: Weight: mg = 2 × 9.8 = 19.6 N down. Normal force: 19.6 N up.
Pull: 10 N to the right. Friction: 4 N to the left.
Net force: 6 N to the right, so a = 3 m s⁻².
